maya: Quick heads-up — saw steady KV cache memory climb on cluster us-west-2a starting ~12:10 UTC, not correlated with request rate. :eyes:
maya: Metric snippet:
```
kv_cache.total_bytes: 1223MB -> 2.1GB over 1h
kv_cache.hit_rate: 0.86 -> 0.84
kv_cache.evictions_total{shard=\"s2\"}: +48
kv_cache.fragment_cluster_count: 12 -> 38
```
maya: flamegraph link: https://go.link/flame/kvcache-coalesce (shows hot path in kvcache::coalesce->append_fragments)
ashwin: Do you have the PromQL you used for the cluster-level trend? want to add to dashboard and correlate with batch size.
maya: PromQL I used:
```
sum by(cluster)(increase(kv_cache.total_bytes{env=\"prod\"}[1h]))
```
ashwin: ok thx. Also try:
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(kv_cache.fragment_size_bucket[5m])) by (le, cluster))
```
to see tail fragment sizes
drew: Could be fragment clustering causing reuse miss — if fragments split differently across slabs reuse drops. Suggest instrumenting `kv_cache.fragment_cluster_reuse_ratio`.
janet: +1. Also let's add an eviction source label (age | pressure | manual) so we can differentiate.
maya: I've added a temporary counter `kv_cache.eviction_source{reason=\"age\"}` on the staging build. Can flip to prod after smoke.
sre-bot: deploy 2949 -> kvcache-probe staging succeeded :white_check_mark:
ashwin: For dashboard: panel ideas — 1) cluster-level total_bytes delta, 2) fragment_cluster_count, 3) fragment_cluster_reuse_ratio, 4) eviction_source breakdown
drew: Also add a sampler that records `kv_cache.kv_scan_ops` when we see >5% growth in 10m window.
maya: Action items:
- janet: add eviction_source labels in core code
- ashwin: dashboard PR with PromQL + alert if bytes delta > 800MB / 10m
- drew: add reuse_ratio counter
- maya: schedule probe rollout to canary at 1400 UTC
maya: Anyone object to alert threshold? It will fire during model syncs sometimes.
janet: set a suppress window for scheduled syncs via silence rule, good call.
maya: thanks — will update thread when canary finishes. /cc @drew
